comment: Per-OS defaults for Tools / External applications (scheme to command). Placeholders: {ip} {port} {name} {type} {category} {url}. A template of just {url} opens the full discovered URL (port + path) with the system default handler. localsmb:// (WNetAddConnection2) and localhttp://, localhttps:// are Windows-native pseudo-schemes opened via ShellExecute (no console flash) — append :{port} to override the port.
